name: Devotion
source:
''Devotion'' is a  heart-driven time-travel game that also deals with '' The many-worlds interpretation ''

The time balance is lost and the timelines/worlds of the universe are preparing to wage war against who they believe is the cause of all of this.

And that person just happens to be ''You''

But fear not. A whole army is by your side and a large cast of characters are fighting for your cause.

But most of all you have ''yourself'' at your side!

So step up, lead your army and save not only your timeline but every timeline in existence.

[From [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/devotion]Itch.io[/url]]
